summary: Jefferson Capital, Inc.'s indirect subsidiary issued $100 million aggregate principal amount of 8.250% Senior Notes due 2030 as an add-on to an existing indenture. The notes were sold to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A and offshore under Regulation S, guaranteed by three intermediate holding companies. Proceeds will repay revolver borrowings and for general corporate purposes. Redemption provisions include a make-whole premium before May 15, 2027, and a 40% equity-clawback at 108.250%. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation. What to watch: note redemption activity, leverage metrics, and portfolio acquisition pace.
